The Facility

Every tool for the work. One membership.

Over 12,000 square feet, laid out so members move from warm-up to lift to recovery without leaving the building — or waiting for equipment.

01

Co-ed Weight Floor

Racks, platforms, plate-loaded machines and full dumbbell range for strength work at any level.

02

Women & Senior Area

A separate, lower-traffic room with its own selectorized equipment and open floor space.

03

HIIT Turf

Sled track, rig, kettlebells and conditioning tools for interval and functional training.

04

Cycling & Aerobics Studio

Dedicated class studio for group cycling, strength and mobility on the weekly schedule.

05

Cardio Deck

Treadmills, ellipticals, rowers and bikes with individual screens, facing the windows.

06

Locker Rooms, Showers & Sauna

Full changing facilities with day lockers and a sauna in each locker room.

Also on site: a pro shop stocked with fitness drinks, supplements and apparel · physical therapy and massage therapy suites · keyfob access 24/7.

Under one roof

Gym. Physical therapy.

Personal Training

Coaching built around your goal, your level and your calendar.

Our trainers write your program, teach the lifts, and adjust week to week. Every membership starts with an orientation session so you know how to use the floor safely from day one.

Nutrition Consultation & Program

A plan you can actually run on a normal week.

Nutrient-dense meal and supplement plans built around whole foods, your fitness goals and your training schedule — not a template.

  • Short- and long-term goals, resting metabolic rate and body composition
  • Personalised meal & supplement plan with macro and calorie breakdowns
  • Pre- and post-workout meal and supplement timing around your training
  • Grocery list and cooking tips
  • Four bi-weekly follow-ups for check-ins, adjustments and accountability

$100 initial consultation

The Team

Ten trainers. One that fits you.

Pick a trainer and book straight into their calendar. New members: any trainer can run your included orientation session.

Recovery & Rehab

The other half of getting stronger.

Licensed practitioners work out of the same building, so training and treatment stay on the same page.

Physical Therapy

Placeholder — PT treatment room

Move without working around pain.

Hunter Burgess, MS, PT has been a licensed physical therapist since 1999, working with professional, Olympic and national-team athletes before returning home to Peterborough. He treats all ages from inside the facility, with full use of the floor for your rehab.

  • Injury assessment and hands-on treatment
  • Return-to-lifting and post-op rehab, programmed on the floor
  • Most insurances accepted

Hours 8 AM–4 PM · Appointments: 603-924-3173

Massage Therapy

Book bodywork the same day you lift.

A massage therapist works on site — an eclectic approach to therapeutic massage and bodywork. Hot stones and essential oils are included in every session.

  • Therapeutic, sports and recovery massage
  • Fascia release for tight, overworked tissue
  • Hot stones & essential oils included

Scheduling: 603-660-1731 or ask at the front desk

Nearly 30 classes a week, included with membership.
